description: Create a whole location tree (buildings, floors, rooms, storage places) in one call, with the same contract as scaffold_categories: without confirm: true it is a dry run that writes nothing (existing same-name locations at the same position are reused, never duplicated); the SAME call with confirm: true commits the tree atomically. parentName references another entry in the same call (existing parents included as entries are reused). Each location is one explicit entry: a range such as "rooms 201 to 210" is ten entries. At most 200 locations per call. Requires the manager role. Idempotent: a repeated commit reuses every node.

confirm.description: true commits the plan; absent or false = dry run, nothing written

locations.description: The whole tree as a flat list, parents referenced by name

parentName.description: Name of the parent location — another entry in this call (omit for top level)

name: scaffold_locations

instruction.description: Preview mode: what the same call with confirm: true would do

preview.description: True = dry run, NOTHING was written; the same call with confirm: true commits it

title: Scaffold location tree
